basics.name: Ayush V. Patel

publications.name: A Duplex Method for Prediction of Concrete Strength Using Dimensionality Reduction
publications.summary: A dual-approach study benchmarking eleven machine-learning regressors for predicting concrete strength, with and without PCA dimensionality reduction. XGBoost achieved the best R2 score of 0.9206.
